# Positive reasons addressed to every situated position

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Under explicit living significance, formation correspondence E and a positioned direct articulation D, every position with actual access to a response has a contributory reason for it, whatever its endorsement, substrate or identity labels. The least reason satisfying D is fixed by access and positive ground alone, so positions alike in access are alike in this reason; a position without access receives no reason from this route. Endorsement independence is the content of D, not a consequence of living significance and E: an endorsement-conditional articulation is compatible with the same living significance and formation facts yet withholds the reason from a non-endorsing position with access.

Canonical source: [SecuredContent.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SecuredContent.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- G0 is unchanged and remains an explicit normative premise; E requires the response to realize some new generative content in every presently grounded continuation.
- D is an explicit positioned practical articulation: access together with positive ground in every continuation supplies a contributory reason. D does not mention endorsement, culture, identity or substrate; the boundary theorem marks this as premise content.
- Positions are differentiated response positions formed within one unfolding; access stands for their formed capacity, standing and availability, not independent agents prior to the history.

The concrete witness reuses the PositiveGroundUncertainty construction: a continuation records the response, a surviving formation model and a future branch; the visible scope is the models still live after acquired evidence. Position substrate and endorsement fields appear only to show that they do not enter the reason. Correspondence of access to real capacity and authority must be stated in each application.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 check: 10 new theorems/25 declaration audits, all with empty axiom reports; the checker requires this module to have none. Inherited modules' propext, Quot.sound and Classical.choice dependencies are listed separately and not migrated; 2 application examples are not counted as new theorems. The first run (8 theorems, 3 with propext and Quot.sound) remains in its retained run directory. No independent review yet.

A contributory reason is not permission, duty, an overall ranking or a uniquely optimal action, and predicts no recognition or compliance. Universality rests on D; neither G0 nor D is derived from an agent's own standpoint, and universal-practical-warrant is not completed.

- An endorsement-conditional articulation is compatible with the same living significance and formation facts yet withholds the reason from a non-endorsing position with access; endorsement independence therefore does not follow from living significance. [PositionedPositiveReason.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/PositionedPositiveReason.lean)
- An endorsing position without access receives no reason from this route; this does not show it has no reason at all. [PositionedPositiveReason.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/PositionedPositiveReason.lean)
